# fundament_namespace (Data Source)

Fetches a single namespace by cluster name, project name, and namespace name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fundament_namespace" "example" {
  cluster_name = "my-cluster"
  project_name = "my-project"
  name         = "app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) The name of the cluster containing the namespace.
- `name` (String) The name of the namespace to look up.
- `project_name` (String) The name of the project owning the namespace.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_id` (String) The ID of the cluster containing the namespace.
- `created` (String) The timestamp when the namespace was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the namespace.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that owns this namespace.
